name: pi-review-gate
description: External pi extension for post-turn code review gates.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run test:run
scripts.test:fast: npm run build:test && npm run test:fast:run
scripts.test:fast:run: node --test --test-concurrency=4 dist-test/tests/config.test.js dist-test/tests/diff.test.js dist-test/tests/execution-progress.test.js dist-test/tests/jsonl.test.js dist-test/tests/little-coder-thinking.test.js dist-test/tests/prompts.test.js dist-test/tests/redaction.test.js dist-test/tests/review-report.test.js dist-test/tests/schema.test.js dist-test/tests/serial-writer.test.js dist-test/tests/state.test.js dist-test/tests/transmission.test.js dist-test/tests/usage.test.js
scripts.test:serial: npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run test:run:serial
